subject: Commit flexibility & launch-window true-up — pricing and grace periods
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <amercer@launchwave.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Questions on monthly commit ramp for Dec launch

Hi Vivek,

We're closing in on our product launch (targeting early Dec) and need to nail the commit/discount structure. A few quick questions:

- We expect heavy traffic in the first 6 weeks (roughly 3-4x baseline). Can you support a month-by-month ramp that lets us step from a modest starting commit up to peak with a true-up after launch?
- Is there room for a launch grace credit or buffer so we don't immediately get penalized for exceeding the first month's commit?
- How do overage rates work during ramp months vs steady-state months?

Attached is our launch plan and a rough token estimate. Would welcome a short proposal that lays out a month 0-3 schedule, suggested discounts by committed volume, and any grace/true-up language you typically offer for product launches.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform
LaunchWave

Attachment: LaunchWave-launch-plan.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Jamie Liu <j.liu@launchwave.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <amercer@launchwave.io>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: launch ramp, true-up, and temporary surge protections

Thanks Vivek — quick procurement redlines after internal review:

- Can you extend the grace credit to 40% for month 1? Our projected peak is higher and the extra buffer materially helps our cash flow during the first 30 days.
- Please reduce the first-60-day overage premium to +15% rather than +20%.
- We need overage caps in writing for the first quarter (we propose a max overage bill of 120% of expected committed spend for Q1).
- Procurement questionnaire attached; please fill and return.

If you can accept these three items we can route the MSA for signatures next week. Also requesting DocuSign so we can keep timelines tight.

Best,
Jamie Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
LaunchWave

Attachment: launchwave_procurement_qs.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <j.liu@launchwave.io>, Alex Mercer <amercer@launchwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: launch ramp, true-up, and temporary surge protections — accepted concessions

Jamie / Alex — appreciate the quick feedback. We can accept the requested concessions with two operational conditions (both standard):

1) Launch grace credit increased to 40% for month 1, applied to invoiceable usage, conditioned on a signed MSA and 50% prepayment of month 1 commit.
2) First-60-day overage premium reduced to +15% (from +20%), with the explicit cap you requested: for Q1 the total billed overage cannot exceed 120% of the expected committed spend for that quarter.

Operational notes: surge buffer up to 120% for day-0 to day-30 still applies. True-up remains 60 days following the quarter. One-time $5k launch credit still applies on the first invoice.

I'll upload the revised proposal (proposal_v2.pdf) and prepare the DocuSign envelope with the MSA and SOW. Please confirm and I'll send the DocuSign link.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 215KB)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-launchwave
